newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Islamic Development Bank extended loans worth $20 billion to member states during the past 22 years.
- Saudi American Bank posts 265 million riyals net profit in the first quarter of 1997.
- Saudi Hollandi Bank posts 46.8 million riyals in the first three months of 1997.
- Al Jazeera Saudi Bank posts 3.9 million riyals in the first three months of 1997.
- Saudi Arabia imports from Malaysia and Indonesia in 1995 were worth 1.28 billion riyals.
